h1:
Chiang Rai Mookata
10 Best-Value Grill Buffets
intro: Mookata is the dinner locals in Chiang Rai pick most often when they meet up with friends. The city has cheap air-conditioned spots with no time limit, places that add fresh seafood, and homey charcoal-grill joints. We picked 10 that get talked about a lot and give you good value per head, with the area, rough pricing and opening hours so you can match the right place to the right budget.

blocks.html: Grill buffets in Chiang Rai roughly split into three groups. The first is air-conditioned, no-time-limit spots at around 219–250 THB that focus on quantity and comfort. The second adds seafood like prawns, shellfish and crab, pushing the price up to around 300–350 THB. The third is homey charcoal-grill places, the cheapest of the lot. We've ranked mainly by value and how heavily reviewed each spot is, but every place on this list gets real local traffic, so pick by your budget and whichever location is easiest for you.

blocks.text: Ranking the 10 best mookata and grill buffets in Chiang Rai

items.name: Kin Mookata Chiang Rai
items.blurb: An air-conditioned, no-time-limit spot on San Khok Chang Road, right next to a 7-Eleven so it's easy to find. The per-head price is low and covers everything with no extra add-ons. Reviewers like the cool, comfortable seating, fresh ingredients and plenty of parking out back. Great for an evening with a group of friends.
items.meta: San Khok Chang Rd, next to 7-Eleven · Open 11:00–23:00 daily

items.name: Moo Kin Moo Katha Branch 2, Ban Du
items.blurb: A mookata buffet in the Ban Du area that people mention for its range of dipping sauces to switch between. The per-head price is low, so it suits anyone on a tight budget who just wants to eat their fill. It's close to Rajabhat University and gets a steady student crowd.
items.meta: Ban Du area, near Rajabhat University · Open evening–late

items.name: Tem Im Mookata, Old Bypass Road
items.blurb: A homey mookata place along the old bypass road. Reviewers say the food line is big, with fresh ingredients, grilled items and desserts, and the price is easy on the wallet. Good if you want a roomy place with simple parking, nothing fancy, just filling and good value.
items.meta: Old Bypass Rd, Chiang Rai · Open evenings

items.name: Pink Lanna Seafood & Mookata, Ban Du
items.blurb: A no-time-limit grill buffet in the Ban Du area. The draw is the seafood section with big prawns, fresh shellfish and crab, plus a fresh-skewer bar you can grab and grill yourself. Reviewers praise how fresh the seafood is and the unlimited refills. It's just before Toyota Ban Du, with lots of parking.
items.meta: Soi Ban Pa Ha, Phahonyothin Rd, Ban Du · Open 16:00–23:00 daily

items.name: Finn Buffet Plus+ Chiang Rai
items.blurb: A mookata and seafood buffet with several price tiers to match your budget. The Plus+ tier at around 349 THB gets you the full seafood spread. Reviewers like the roomy space and wide selection. Good for anyone who wants seafood on the side but still wants to keep the budget in check.

items.name: Wiang Luang Mookata Seafood
items.blurb: A no-time-limit buffet built around seafood, with prawns, crab and shellfish. You can add a grill for a small extra charge. Reviewers rate it well for freshness. Good for anyone who likes both the dip-and-boil and the grill in one meal.

items.name: Plai Fa Mookata
items.blurb: A cheap mookata spot that reviewers praise for fresh ingredients and tasty dipping sauce, and it keeps scoring well. Good if you want a small place with a relaxed feel and friendly prices, whether you go on your own or with a small group of friends.

items.name: Than Thong Kho Khun, Pa Yaeng Kham
items.blurb: A charcoal-grill spot that reviewers rate highly for its meat. It uses a brass pan over charcoal heat with good-quality grain-fed beef. Suited to anyone who's after the charcoal smell and the meat itself more than an all-you-can-pile buffet.
items.meta: Pa Yaeng Kham area, Chiang Rai · Open evenings

items.name: Khun Ui Mookata
items.blurb: A homey mookata place that locals go to regularly. Reviewers mention the freshly sliced pork belly and fresh squid, and the prices are friendly. Good for anyone who wants a local spot that isn't fancy, just easy and laid-back.

items.name: Phu Phu Ra View Dao, Mae Sai
items.blurb: A rooftop grill spot with mountain views near Mae Sai. Good if you're driving north toward the border and want mookata with an evening view. It has a range of dipping sauces and works better as a stop on an out-of-town trip than as a meal in the city.
items.meta: Mae Sai area (heading north) · Open evenings

blocks.title: Tip
blocks.html: No-time-limit air-conditioned buffets like Kin Mookata get busy in the early evening on Fridays and Saturdays. If you're coming with a big group, go before 18:00 or call to book a table. At seafood places like Pink Lanna and Wiang Luang, the fresh seafood tends to run out fast later in the night, so go right after they open if you want the full spread of prawns, shellfish and crab.

blocks.text: How to pick the best value for your budget

items: Cheapest, just eat your fill — Kin Mookata, Moo Kin Moo Katha or Tem Im Mookata, around 219–250 THB per head, no time limit, easy and relaxed.
Want seafood on the side — Pink Lanna, Wiang Luang or Finn Plus+ have prawns, shellfish and crab with unlimited refills, around 299–349 THB.
For the meat and charcoal smell — Than Thong Kho Khun focuses on charcoal-grilled grain-fed beef, suited to anyone who eats mostly meat rather than piling up a buffet.
Want a view mid-trip — Phu Phu Ra View Dao in Mae Sai suits anyone touring the north who wants a grill with an evening view.

blocks.text: Ban Du area vs the city center

blocks.html: The Ban Du area to the north of the city has the densest cluster of grill buffets, because it's near Rajabhat University, with both cheap spots and seafood places. It suits anyone staying around Ban Du or able to drive. In the city center you'll find air-conditioned spots like Kin Mookata and charcoal-grill places scattered around, easy to reach if you're staying near the Clock Tower or the Night Bazaar.

items.name: Ban Du area
items.blurb: The densest cluster of grill buffets, with both cheap spots and seafood places like Pink Lanna. Good for anyone staying north of the city.

items.name: City center
items.blurb: Air-conditioned spots like Kin Mookata and charcoal-grill places, easy to reach from the Clock Tower and Night Bazaar areas.

faq.q: Which Chiang Rai mookata is the best value and cheapest?
faq.a: No-time-limit air-conditioned spots like Kin Mookata on San Khok Chang Road run around 219–248 THB per head and cover everything, and Moo Kin Moo Katha in Ban Du is around 229 THB — both are good value for anyone on a tight budget who wants to eat their fill. Tem Im Mookata along the old bypass road is also cheap with a big food line.

faq.q: Which Chiang Rai mookata has seafood?
faq.a: Pink Lanna Seafood & Mookata in Ban Du has prawns, shellfish and crab plus a fresh-ingredients bar to grill, at around 259–329 THB. Wiang Luang Mookata Seafood is around 299 THB, and Finn Buffet Plus+ has a seafood tier around 349 THB. They suit anyone who wants both the grill and seafood in one meal.

faq.q: What time does mookata in Chiang Rai open?
faq.a: Most open from evening into the late hours — for example, Kin Mookata is open 11:00–23:00 daily, and Pink Lanna in Ban Du is open 16:00–23:00 daily. Most buffets are a dinner thing, so go early in the evening to avoid the queue and catch the fresh ingredients before they run out.

faq.q: Roughly how much does a mookata buffet in Chiang Rai cost?
faq.a: Per-head prices run around 219–350 THB. Standard no-time-limit air-conditioned spots start around 219–250 THB, while places that add seafood like prawns, shellfish and crab move up to around 299–349 THB — good value given how much you can eat with no limit.

faq.q: Which place has comfortable air-conditioned mookata seating?
faq.a: Kin Mookata Chiang Rai on San Khok Chang Road, next to a 7-Eleven, is an air-conditioned, no-time-limit spot with plenty of parking out back. Reviewers praise the cool, comfortable seating and fresh ingredients. It's open 11:00–23:00 daily and is good for a group of friends or family.
